question: Four terms have been given in options, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.

Option 1) 13MN

Option 2) 3CX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/165e5168007d2d6e8c47cf7b5b37a84e53f7d567f58a2b13aee89356574793c5.png]
